question: Should ClawHub accept this core-owned runtime promotions surface and the production feed snapshot publish step now?
rationale: The PR is technically coherent but creates permanent platform state, public/admin API contracts, and production deploy behavior that automation cannot accept on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Accept After Deploy Proof
options.body: Verify the promotions snapshot publish command on a safe deployment path, then undraft and merge the feature as a ClawHub-owned platform surface.

options.title: Keep Draft Until Consumer Lands
options.body: Leave the PR open but draft until the OpenClaw CLI promotions consumer and release plan are ready enough to make the hosted contract useful.

options.title: Do Not Add Core Promotions Yet
options.body: Close or narrow the PR if maintainers decide promotional offers should not become a ClawHub core platform surface at this time.

recommendation.title: Accept After Deploy Proof
recommendation.body: Verify the promotions snapshot publish command on a safe deployment path, then undraft and merge the feature as a ClawHub-owned platform surface.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current feature branch and have prior adjacent catalog-surface history, making them the best available routing point for the product/release decision.
